gold: Drug-induced blepharitis and ectropion associated with TNF-α inhibitors (infliximab and adalimumab)

selector.rationale: Blepharitis best explains the bilateral scaly, thickened, and erythematous upper and lower eyelids, crusty plaques on the eyelid margins, and is directly mentioned in the image description.

rejected.label: Conjunctival hyperemia
rejected.why: While present, it is not as specific or explanatory as Blepharitis for the overall clinical presentation.

rejected.label: Conjunctivitis
rejected.why: Lacks specific findings to support this diagnosis over Blepharitis, despite some shared symptoms like conjunctival hyperemia.
